scripts.check: bun run check:ts && cargo fmt --check && bun run lint:rust && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:ts: biome check packages scripts && bun test --preload @opentui/solid/preload packages/tui/src
scripts.coverage: bun run coverage:ts && bun run coverage:rust
scripts.coverage:rust: cargo llvm-cov --workspace --fail-under-lines 95 --fail-under-functions 95 --lcov --output-path coverage/rust.lcov && cargo llvm-cov report
scripts.format: biome check --write packages scripts && cargo fmt
